verification.note: Every factual point in the finding holds. useFocusMode.ts:106-109: `toggleFocusMode(layoutChanges = true)` calls rememberReadingAnchor() only when layoutChanges is true. FocusModeShortcuts.tsx:17,23 passes `wide` from useIsWideViewport. FocusModeButton.tsx:17 and TreeToggle.tsx:30 call it with no argument, so the default true applies. The anchor is spent only by AppShell.tsx:311-313, a useLayoutEffect keyed on [focusLayout], and focusLayout comes from useFocusLayout, which is state && useIsFilePageUrl && wide (useFocusMode.ts:90-95). The caller-side flag is therefore a second derivation of when the layout changes. I found no case where the two disagree at this commit: the shortcut is active only when filePageUrl is true (AppShell.tsx:334); FocusModeButton is not drawn when isMobile (FileDetailChrome.tsx:146); TreeToggle calls toggleFocusMode only inside `if (focusLayout)`; and useIsMobile (innerWidth < 768) and useIsWideViewport (innerWidth >= 768) both use MOBILE_BREAKPOINT, so they are exact complements. The finding is confirmed as a coupling and maintainability observation, not as a divergence that shows up today.

specification_compliance: For F1, at this commit the flag each caller passes to toggleFocusMode matches the change in useFocusLayout for all three callers. I found no breach of I2's reading-anchor clause along these paths.
potential_unspecified_behavior: If a future caller of toggleFocusMode() relies on the default layoutChanges=true while the URL is not a file page URL, or below 768px, it would leave a stale pending anchor. A later focusLayout change, such as a resize, would then spend that anchor at a reading position the reader has already left.
regression_risks: The anchor decision is made by each caller and is not derived from useFocusLayout. A change to the file-page-URL test, for example driveUnavailableStore, or to the breakpoint can make the two disagree without any error.
test_coverage: I did not check whether any test asserts that no anchor is taken below 768px, or that one is taken from the button and the tree toggle paths.
not_verified: I did not run any test or browser reproduction; this verification is static reading only.
I did not trace whether FileHeaderRowPortal drops `trailing` when the page is not hosted, or whether FileDetailChrome can render while driveUnavailableStore is true.
I did not check whether the first render of useIsWideViewport (from the initial state) and of useIsMobile can differ during hydration.
